game_title: Sentinel Loop – Torchlit Cave Mouth Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Sentinel Loop: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the torchbearer ahead. Then check the queue_length value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the lantern post by solving code steps involving queue_length that move the torchbearer forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the lantern post first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Sentinel Loop
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Sentinel Loop' (Week 4 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Torchlit Cave Mouth'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_length changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
